description: This file defines the CategoryContentWrapper class, which implements ContentWrapper for handling category content display within the OFbiz framework. It manages content retrieval, caching, and rendering related to product categories.

classes.name: CategoryContentWrapper
classes.description: Implements ContentWrapper to fetch, cache, and render category content for display purposes in OFBiz.

methods.name: makeCategoryContentWrapper
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of CategoryContentWrapper using a product category and HTTP request.

methods.name: CategoryContentWrapper (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a CategoryContentWrapper with specified dispatcher, category, locale, and mime type.

methods.name: CategoryContentWrapper (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a CategoryContentWrapper from a product category and HTTP request, extracting dispatcher, locale, and mime type.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns category content as a StringWrapper for specified content type and encoder.

methods.name: getProductCategoryContentAsText (static)
methods.description: Retrieves category content as raw text, given a product category and request context.

methods.name: getProductCategoryContentAsText (static)
methods.description: Retrieves category content as text with explicit locale and dispatcher.

methods.name: getProductCategoryContentAsText (static)
methods.description: Core static method that retrieves and optionally caches category content as text, given detailed context including delegator, dispatcher, locale, mime type, and encoding.

methods.name: getProductCategoryContentAsText (static)
methods.description: Internal static method to fetch content and write it to a provided Writer, with cache control.
